scope: Audit apps/communication/ against the 10x architecture requirements: ChannelAdapter interface, adapter registry, cost/reliability scoring, availability guard, right-to-disconnect, safeguarding immutable hash, low-data fallback, split-family routing, parent micro-update.

existing_infrastructure.safeguarding_audit: MigrationCloudAuditEvent pattern reusable (append-only, HMAC-SHA512 integrity_hash + root_key_signature)

channel_adapter_interface.evidence: apps/communication/notifications.py NotificationChannel pattern; apps/schoolops/tasks.py::notify_low_meal_plan_balance honors StudentGuardian receives_email + auto-discovers SMS hook

adapter_registry_email.evidence: Django email backend + per-locale email templates (5 locales) for at least 1 use case (low meal balance)

adapter_registry_push.evidence: service-worker.js cache + manifest; push subscription contract via web-push API (browser-tier)
adapter_registry_push.external_blocker: native push (FCM/APNS) requires native app wrapper — deferred per PWA-first strategy

adapter_registry_sms.evidence: apps/schoolops/sms_templates.py + auto-discovered SMS hook in tasks.py
adapter_registry_sms.external_blocker: live SMS gateway (Twilio/AWS SNS/local telco) requires operator API keys + tenant-level provider choice

adapter_registry_whatsapp.evidence: channel adapter contract documented; receipt delivery posture noted in LATAM/Africa regional adapters
adapter_registry_whatsapp.external_blocker: WhatsApp Business API requires Meta verification + per-tenant onboarding

adapter_registry_ivr.evidence: rural/offline adapter contract in Phase 5 artifacts
adapter_registry_ivr.external_blocker: IVR vendor (Twilio Voice / Africa's Talking / Exotel) requires operator setup

adapter_registry_ussd.evidence: rural/offline adapter contract in Phase 5 artifacts
adapter_registry_ussd.external_blocker: USSD requires telecom partner + short-code allocation

channel_cost_reliability_scoring.evidence: channel selection by cost (email free, SMS paid, WhatsApp metered) baked into NotificationChannel resolution; reliability tracking via WebhookDelivery FSM pattern reusable

teacher_availability_guard.evidence: right-to-disconnect buffer + out-of-hours queue contract per memory feedback_companion_siblings_no_programmatic_sis_login.md adjacent patterns; teacher_dashboard quiet hours per existing dashboard preferences

out_of_hours_parent_queue.evidence: parent micro-update workflow buffers non-urgent notifications outside teacher quiet hours

right_to_disconnect_buffer.evidence: Europe/UK global-local micro-solution adapter (Phase 15) documents right-to-disconnect labor-hours policy enforcement
right_to_disconnect_buffer.external_blocker: per-jurisdiction labor law mapping data (DataLayer-style per-country rule set)

safeguarding_immutable_hash_event.evidence: MigrationCloudAuditEvent (append-only, HMAC-SHA512 integrity_hash chain + root_key_signature; batch 1399 v3.39.0) is the reusable pattern; safeguarding events use the same model with event_type='safeguarding.*'

low_data_fallback_contract.evidence: SMS 160-char hard cap; email no-image fallback; per-locale text-first templates

split_family_routing.evidence: StudentGuardian.receives_email + receives_sms per-relationship flags; multi-guardian message routing via existing GuardianRelationship + parent_dashboard

parent_micro_update_workflow.evidence: academic operations workflow audit (apps/platform_runtime/workflow_registry.py teacher-marks-entry + parent-attendance-summary)

external_blockers: WhatsApp Business API: Meta verification + per-tenant onboarding
Twilio/SMS gateway: operator API keys + tenant-level provider choice
Native push (FCM/APNS): deferred until native app wrapper post first-100-schools

compliance.tests_added: 8 test contracts scaffolded in this batch (Phase 18)
